name: s81lk_kp4_dsyn-t2-COMMIT
purpose: S81 link KP4 decoder tile dsyn (align, syndromes, 3 RiBM) of the 4-tile cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec, 10-17. Bench = bit-exact equivalence of the cluster vs the 33a35eb7d decoder (+ rs544.py exactness) and the syndrome mutant DMUT 3.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_kp4_dsyn u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_common.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_bm.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_dsyn.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dsyn/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dsyn/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_dsyn --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_kp4_dsyn  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-TILES2 10-17: four-tile re-split of the KP4 decoder cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec (replaces s81lk_kp4_deca / decb, REJECTED at their CTS gates: 259.2 um tiles, SRAM in the middle, clock on the S face; TT insertion 307-455 / 295-417 ps, spread 148 / 122 ps).  Cluster 2 x 2: dsyn SW (PMA in W), ddly NW, dchn SE, dout NE (beats out E); every seam registered at both pins.  Bit-exact vs the 33a35eb7d two-tile decoder on every output and cycle (tb_s81_kp4_eq: RTL same cycle, hardware view with all tile pin registers = reference + 2 cycles; mutants DMUT 2 / 3 and a one-short word seam FAIL).  dsyn: alignment on registered am_ok / p_v, syndromes on the arriving stream, 3 RiBM key-equation units and the 3:1 result select; no macro; 172.8 um square (deca std ~15.6k um2 less the SRAM -> util ~0.55; enc's 7k-sink 151-194 um tiles measured TT insertion 192-243 ps, spread 32); p_d full W face (3.3/um), x_q full N face to ddly, k_* full E face to dchn, clk S centre (cluster outer face).
